  • AbuAliExpress: קבוצת ההאקרים הפרו‑פלסטינית חנט'לה טוענת: "חדרנו לליבו של צבא האויב הציוני."

  • סיכום: אין מספיק ראיות להערכת מגמת האיום.

6.en:
Situation report — last 6 hours

  • Strike — Houthis: Ansar Allah says it struck Saudi Arabia’s headquarters in Aden with a ballistic missile. Blast reported in Aden (TASS, Al Jazeera).
  • Strike/Kill — Gaza: IDF and ISA announced they eliminated a Hamas Nukhba operative involved in planning the explosive-device attack that killed four soldiers from the 52nd Battalion tank crew.
  • UK action: Britain will send additional forces and deploy fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks.
  • Iraq border: Iraq closed the Sheeb crossing with Iran and shut most checkpoints along the Iran border “until further notice.”
  • Diplomacy/legal: Germany summoned the Iranian envoy after a court convicted spies in plots against Jewish leaders.
  • Humanitarian: Reports that Gaza children face worsening food shortages as prices rise and aid is cut.
  • Economy: Oil returned to about $110/barrel after Iran–Pakistan talks yielded no result.
  • Domestic/security: Malaysia banned civil servants from using Waze citing links to Israel. Reports of vandalism of subway machines in Israel over alleged ties to the IDF.
  • Defense tech: Spain, Germany and Belgium developing autonomous in‑flight refuelling for drones (report).
  • Voting: IDF says soldiers and commanders began voting; >850 military polling stations deployed.
  • Allegations: Al Jazeera reports Israeli soldiers mocked a Lebanese home they had rigged with explosives.
  • Bottom line: Insufficient evidence to assess a wider trend in threat level from these reports alone.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF/ISA eliminated a planner of a deadly attack; IDF says it did not plan to strike Iran before the election; Israel accepted as Pacific Islands Forum partner; soldiers enabled to vote.

  • הומניטרי: דיווחים על החמרת מחסור במזון בעזה, עליית מחירים וקטיעת סיוע.
  • כלכלה: מחיר הנפט חזר לכ-110$ לחבית לאחר כישלון משא ומתן בין איראן לפקיסטן.
  • ביטחון פנים: מלזיה אסרה על עובדי ציבור להשתמש ב‑Waze בטענה לקשרים עם ישראל. דיווחים על השחתת מכונות מטרו בישראל בטענה לקשרים עם צה"ל.
  • טכנולוגיית ביטחון: ספרד, גרמניה ובלגיה מפתחות תדלוק אווירי אוטונומי למטוסי טרם (דיווח).

  • טענות התנהגות: אל-ג'זירה מדווחת על חיילי צה"ל שהשמיצו בית בלבנון שהיה מותקן בפצצות.
  • סיכום: הראיות שבדיווחים אלה אינן מספקות להערכת מגמת איום כוללת.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: צה"ל/השב"כ חיסלו מתכנן פיגוע קטלני; דיווח כי לא הייתה כוונה לתקוף את איראן לפני הבחירות; ישראל התקבלה כשותפה בפורום איי הפסיפיק; חיילים מורשים להצביע.

24.en:
Situation Report — Iran‑Israel‑US conflict (latest 24h)

  • Active strike: Houthis claim they struck Saudi Arabia’s headquarters in Aden with a ballistic missile; blasts reported in Aden (TASS / Al Jazeera).
  • Regional military movements
    • Britain to send additional forces and fighter jets to defend Saudi cities and infrastructure from Houthi attacks (intelslava).
    • Iraq closed the Sheeb border crossing and most checkpoints with Iran citing alleged Tehran involvement in attacks on Saudi Arabia (Reuters / TASS).
  • Israel security operations
    • IDF and ISA announced they eliminated a Hamas Nukhba operative involved in planning the explosive-device attack that killed four tank‑crew soldiers from the 52nd Battalion (idfofficial / AbuAliExpress).
    • Media reports conflict on Iran strike plans: The Jerusalem Post reports IDF did not plan an Iran strike before the election; separate reports claim an order to prepare for a large‑scale strike was issued (Good News ME; Financial Times report cited by other outlets).
  • Cyber / information
    • Iran‑aligned hacker group (claimed) says it penetrated Israeli military systems (AbuAliExpress).
    • Reports that Israeli soldiers mocked a Lebanese home rigged with explosives (Al Jazeera / local outlets).
  • Diplomacy & legal
    • Germany summoned the Iranian envoy after a court convicted spies in plots against Jewish leaders (Times of Israel).
    • Israel accepted as a Pacific Islands Forum partner, per Israel’s foreign ministry (Times of Israel).
    • Malaysia banned civil servants from using the mapping app Waze due to alleged links to Israel (Reuters).
  • Economy Oil returned to about $110/barrel after talks between Iran and Pakistan yielded no progress (CIG_telegram).
  • Bottom line: Trend — Regional escalation evident. Supported by Houthi missile strike in Aden, UK force deployments to Saudi, and Iraq’s border closures. Insufficient evidence to assess immediate direct strikes on Iran from Israel.
  • 🟢 Good News:
    • IDF/ISA elimination of a terror planner involved in the attack that killed four soldiers.
    • Report that IDF did not plan a pre‑election strike on Iran (calming media report).
    • Israel accepted as Pacific Islands Forum partner.

48.en:
Situation Report — Iran‑Israel‑US (last 48h)

  • Strike: Houthis launched a ballistic missile at Saudi Arabia’s headquarters in Aden; a blast was reported.

Regional & Gulf

  • Britain will deploy additional forces and fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks (reported).
  • Iraq closed the Sheeb crossing and most checkpoints with Iran “until further notice,” citing evidence of Tehran’s involvement in attacks on Saudi targets.
  • Oil returned to ~$110/barrel after Iran–Pakistan talks yielded no progress (market report).

Israel — operations & security

  • IDF and ISA announced they eliminated a Hamas Nukhba operative who helped plan the explosive attack that killed four soldiers from the 52nd Battalion.
  • IDF conducted a raid in Deir Jarir to prevent a reported Palestinian provocation at an olive harvest event.
  • Reports that IDF is preparing for threats ahead of elections; soldiers and commanders deployed to over 850 polling stations nationwide.

Iran-linked activity & diplomacy

  • An Iranian pro‑Palestinian hacker group claimed it breached the “heart” of the Israeli military (self‑claim).
  • Germany summoned the Iranian envoy after a court convicted spies in plots against Jewish leaders (reported).
  • Media reports claim a past Israeli order to prepare a large‑scale attack on Iran (reporting, not confirmed).

Other developments

  • Malaysia banned civil servants from using Waze, citing links to Israel.
  • Spain, Germany and Belgium reported work on autonomous in‑flight drone refuelling (defence report).
  • Israel accepted as a partner of the Pacific Islands Forum (diplomatic report); cultural events in the US highlighted ties to Israel.

Threat trend

  • Elevated regional tension — Houthi missile strikes, border closures, and foreign force deployments indicate rising Gulf/Yemen escalation. Insufficient evidence of direct new strikes on Iran from these reports.

🟢 Good News

  • IDF/ISA elimination of a Hamas operative involved in the deadly tank‑crew attack.
  • IDF deployed voting stations so soldiers and commanders can vote.
  • Reporting that IDF did not plan a strike on Iran before the election.
